title: Machi Koro-style top icon spec
purpose: Reusable specification for generating a small category icon to be placed before the top card title. The icon should match the simple, flat, friendly board-game style used by the rest of the card system.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the icon asset, to be composited later into the title row of a Machi Koro-style card.
integration_context.composition: single centered icon with generous padding around it

style_goal.primary_rule: Match the same clean, flat, simple vector/board-game icon language as the rest of the card UI.
style_goal.secondary_rule: Keep it minimal and highly legible at small size.
style_goal.visual_character: friendly, compact, geometric, slightly rounded, simple and iconic

content.subject: simple house logo
content.description: A small, clean pictogram of a house: triangular roof, rectangular body, and simple door/window structure. The icon should read instantly as a house.
content.silhouette_priority: The silhouette must remain clear and recognizable even at very small size.

construction: use a small number of large clean shapes
use simple cutouts or negative-space windows if helpful

color.description: Single main icon color supplied as a hex value. For the first icon, use the same dark blue family as the card footer.
color.usage_rule: Render the icon primarily in this supplied color. If needed, allow only tiny tonal variation within the same family, but keep the icon effectively single-color.

rendering.linework: prefer filled shapes over outlined drawing; if outlines are used, keep them bold and clean

scalability.small_size_behavior: The icon should stay readable when reduced to a small badge size.
scalability.legibility_rule: Prioritize bold silhouette and simple internal structure over detail.

anti_patterns: do not generate a full card
do not add text or labels
do not add a circular badge background unless explicitly requested later
do not use gradients or realistic shading
do not make the icon look like clip-art from a different style family
do not place the icon off-center
final_prompt_summary: Generate a square icon asset with a transparent background. Draw a simple centered house pictogram in a clean flat board-game/vector style, matching the friendly minimal UI language of Machi Koro-like card furniture. Use the supplied hex color as the main icon color; for now use the same dark blue as the card footer. Keep the icon highly legible, compact, and production-ready, with a clear house silhouette and very low detail.
